items.title: EME Q2 Deep Dive: Data Center Demand and Strategic Acquisitions Drive Growth
items.summary: Specialty construction contractor company EMCOR (NYSE:EME) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 19.8% year on year to $5.15 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $20.25 billion at the midpoint came in 6.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its GAAP profit of $9.06 per share was 25.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
